scripts.test:rules: node scripts/build-rules.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-pe27 'vitest run -c vitest.rules.config.ts'
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:functions: node scripts/build-rules.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,database,auth --project demo-pe27 'vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts'
scripts.emulators: node scripts/build-rules.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,database,auth --project demo-pe27
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run rules:build && firebase deploy --only database,functions --force
